name: ATM Command 5 Code
definition: Type of command performed by the ATM.

ABAL.name: ATM Balance
ABAL.definition: Provide the ATM counters, resetting those that are applicable.

CCNT.name: Counters Inquiry
CCNT.definition: Request the value of the ATM counters.

RPTC.name: Counters Report
RPTC.definition: Provide the value of the ATM counters, no reinitialisation of the counters.
